name: @nexusai/worker
description: Long-running Node process for work that must outlive a serverless request: embedding backfills, heavy ingestion, scheduled maintenance.
comment:dependencies: Bundling inlines @nexusai/* into dist, so every module left external becomes an import the WORKER itself must resolve — even those originally required by core or db. With pnpm's isolated node_modules, undeclared transitive packages are simply absent at runtime. This list must stay in sync with `external` in tsup.config.ts.
